subject: Software for client-consultation recaps at Carla Seed Accountancy
body:
Dear Carla Seed,

I noticed that Carla Seed Accountancy operates as a "small accountancy firm in Stockport, providing a personalised professional service to local business owners and individuals in the Stockport and South Manchester areas."

At UshaLabs, we build software that turns meeting recordings or transcripts into structured minutes, decisions and action items. We would like to explore a reviewed client-consultation recap and follow-up checklist for a small accountancy practice.

Would you be open to exploring how this might fit into your consultations?

Best regards,
UshaLabs team
UshaLabs

If this is relevant to your practice, would a brief introductory conversation be useful?
